newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake says INS probes AccuStaff temps.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake says INS probes AccuStaff temps.

text.p: Chesapeake Corp said Wednesday that officials from two government agencies escorted from the premises of one of its facilities an undetermined number of individuals provided by temporary employment agency AccuStaff Inc.

In a press release, Chesapeake said that the U.S. Department of Immigration and Naturalization Services and the Department of Wage and Labor visited the Cincinnati custom packing facility of Chesapeake Display and Packaging Co.

"None of the individuals who left with INS officials was employed by Chesapeake Display and Packaging. All of the people being questioned were employees of AccuStaff," a company spoekswoman stated in the release.
"Chesapeake has no affiliation with AccuStaff other than as a client of the temporary staffing services provided by AccuStaff," she said.
Chesapeake said that the AccuStaff district manager in Cincinnati maintains a trailer office next to the Chesapeake Display and Packaging location.
A spokeswoman for AccuStaff was not immediately available to comment.
